policy: TuneItVerse ships against adapters you already own. Custom VerseLink hardware is parked.

adapters.name: OBDLink MX+
adapters.notes: Daily driver for live data, VIN, DTCs, and guided work when the protocol path is ELM ASCII.

adapters.name: ELM327-class USB/BT
adapters.notes: Good for diagnostics. Not a substitute for a real J2534 device on locked programming sessions.

adapters.name: J2534 pass-thru
adapters.notes: Connected only when PassThru opens a real FunctionLibrary path.

adapters.name: VerseLink Apex
adapters.notes: Custom JRTuners hardware. PCB/KiCad work stopped 2026-09-23. Not required to use TuneItVerse.
